summary.text: Tommy Stinnett, listed by Ballotpedia as Tom Stinnett, is a Republican state representative who has represented Tennessee House of Representatives District 20 since November 5, 2024, and he is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Tom Stinnett earned a bachelor's degree from East Tennessee State University, and his career experience includes working as a STEM teacher.
He succeeded Bryan Richey in the District 20 seat.
